title: Non-cryptographic random module used where a secret may be generated in nim — review required
description: random.randomize seeds a Mersenne Twister-style generator that is not cryptographically secure. Values derived from it are predictable once enough output is observed, which is fatal for tokens, reset codes and keys. The rule flags the API; whether the value is security-relevant is a review decision.
remediation: Use a CSPRNG such as std/sysrand or the operating system generator for every security value.
limitation: Lexical: matches randomize and rand calls from the stdlib random module; non-security sampling is still reported.
